title: TheHyperArtifacts
description:
The mod will add 11 new weapons to the game.

The mod is NOT made to play without additional mods because some THA weapons are imbalanced for vanilla minecraft
body:
The mod adds 11 new weapons to the game.

Note: the mod is NOT made to play without additional mods because some THA weapons are imbalanced for vanilla Minecraft.

**Weapons added:**

**Emerald Sword** — Holding the Emerald Sword gives you the Hero of the Village effect.

**Sun Hammer** — Hitting a mob with the Sun Hammer sets the mob ablaze, keeping it in the inventory gives you the Fire Resistance effect.

**Wither Scythe** — Gives the Wither effect to any mob the player hits with it. Additionally, after killing one mob you can shoot a Wither Skull by pressing RMB.

**Knight Sword** — Hitting a mob with the Knight Sword will slow it down.

**Legendary Artefact** — Gives you Speed III, Regeneration III, Strength III and Jump Boost III while held in your inventory.

**Fire Glove** — Grants you with the ability to shoot fireballs.

**Bone Dagger** — Allows you to dash in the direction you're looking at by pressing RMB.

**Lighting Book** — Shoots projectiles that, on impact, summon a lightning strike.

**Topaz Pickaxe** — Gives you Haste III when held.

**Bone Shield** — Just a strong shield.

**Ender Sword** — Launches all mobs in a 15 block radius into the sky.
